bathroom-0.inspectorNotes: There is an exhaust fan located in water closet not near shower.  Showers and tubs put moisture into the air, exhaust fan primary function is to remove humidity from the bathroom.  There are operable windows in bathroom, however often times windows are not opened in the heating season.

bathroom-2.inspectorNotes: This room is doubled.  There is only one primary bathroom and the information is above

bathroom-3.inspectorNotes:
The right side, when looking at mirror, sink has a slow drain.  Slow drains can cause leaks in plumbing joints.  Recommend cleaning drain.

Caulking on counter top and escutcheon plate should be done.

bathroom-4.inspectorNotes:
Caulking is deteriorating.  

There is cracking on drywall above shower door.  Infrared camera and moisture meter had normal readings.  Recommend monitoring

bathroom-5.inspectorNotes: Cable is most likely far enough away from wax ring that damage will not occur.  If there is an odor of sewer gas in the bathroom recommend contacting plumber.
